plan.major: Business Administration with a concentration in Digital Marketing
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Business Administration with a concentration in Digital Marketing Major (BA) program page (poid=952). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the major requirement only; the full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. No course in this program carries a lab corequisite. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The catalog states the major requires 11 core courses for a minimum of 33 semester hours, 3 digital marketing courses for 9 semester hours, and one writing intensive course for 3 semester hours; no grand total is printed, and the recorded total (45) is the exact sum of the three stated blocks. Every named course is printed at 3 Hour(s) on its detail page. Residency as printed: at least seven of the required business administration core courses, including BUAD 350 Strategic Management Capstone with Portfolio, must be taken at Salem. The major is offered in collaboration with Rize Education; the concentration courses are taught online by Rize-affiliated faculty per the catalog. Catalog anomaly disclosed, not corrected: the introductory paragraph states the concentration in digital marketing 'requires four courses that are only taught online by Rize-affiliated faculty', but the concentration block lists only three courses (MKTG 240, MKTG 260, MKTG 330); MKTG 230 Principles of Marketing sits in the core block, not the concentration block, and is recorded there. The writing-intensive block is headed 'not SALEM courses' as printed and also allows 'any non-SALEM course with writing intensive designation (WI)'; the five named courses are carried as the choice slot's options and the open-ended alternative is disclosed here and on the slot. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan, disclosed and not recorded: BUAD 240 requires MATH 060, MATH 070 or MATH 100; FINC 302 requires MATH 060, MATH 070 or MATH 100 in addition to its recorded ACCT 120; MKTG 330 requires MATH 060 (or higher) in addition to its recorded prerequisites. MKTG 260 and MKTG 330 also require status as a Business Administration major or permission of the program director, as printed.

courses.title: Writing Intensive Course
courses.choice_note: Select one writing intensive (WI) course per the program page. The catalog names the five options listed here and also allows any non-SALEM course with a writing intensive designation (WI); that open-ended alternative cannot be enumerated and is disclosed in the plan notes. All five named options are printed at 3 Hour(s).
